summary: ARGENX SE filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Q1 2026 earnings press release and investor presentation. The filing reports $1.3 billion in global product net sales (63% YoY growth) and provides a business update on VYVGART, pipeline candidates, and upcoming FDA decisions. There are no M&A, activist, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change events. This is a routine foreign private issuer earnings report, not a special situation.
